quarterly_data.quarter: Taiwan Glass Industry AGM handbook: 2025 Business Report (06-12-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Management: the company's low dielectric (Low Dk) and low coefficient of thermal expansion (Low CTE) glass fiber cloth products have been widely certified and adopted by major global customers (not named); capacity expansion projects are underway at the Taoyuan and Lukang factories. Besides expanding existing low-Dk fiberglass fabric lines, it is accelerating development of products with even lower dielectric constant and lower dielectric loss, and developing low-CTE fiberglass fabric for thinner IC substrates to prevent warpage.

quarterly_data.quarter: Taiwan Glass Industry AGM handbook: 2025 Business Report (06-12-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Outlook: management expects AI and high-speed transmission to keep increasing demand for high-quality glass fiber cloth, giving the fiber business new momentum; in China, construction demand remains weak and float-glass oversupply has not been significantly alleviated, so the company is focusing on high value-added energy-saving and photovoltaic glass.

quarterly_data.quarter: Taiwan Glass Industry AGM handbook: 2025 Business Report (06-12-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: The TF2 flat-glass furnace at the Taichung Factory will undergo a cold repair in 2026 (with waste-heat power generation and natural-gas hydrogen production systems installed during the repair) and is expected to be reignited and resume operations in the first quarter of 2027.
